subject: Clarifying billing for compliance add-ons and pilot concessions
messages:
From: Alex Park <alex.park@medvera.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com
Date: 2028-03-05T09:12:00Z
Subject: Clarify compliance add-on billing for pilot

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for the call yesterday — MedVera's procurement team asked for a tight write-up on how you charge for the compliance bundle so we can compare apples-to-apples across vendors. A few specific asks:

- Audit log retention: what are the tiered retention options and monthly costs (30 / 90 / 365 days)?
- KMS/HSM: do you price this as a per-seat monthly fee, a fixed setup + monthly, or a throughput-based add-on?
- Data residency: what is the surcharge for EU-region residency vs your hosted baseline?
- Pilot discounts: we want a 6-month pilot (low volume). Is there a pilot concession (discount or setup waiver) you can offer, and what are the gating commitments?

We need something procurement can review by EOD Friday to keep their vendor short-list moving. I attached the RFP excerpt they sent.

Appreciate a concise table/ballpark if exact numbers need legal review.

Best,
Alex
Alex Park
Head of Infrastructure & Security
MedVera Health

Attachments: MedVera_RFP_Excerpt.pdf

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Alex Park <alex.park@medvera.com>
Date: 2028-03-05T12:08:00Z
Subject: Re: Clarify compliance add-on billing for pilot

Hi Alex — thanks, putting a short, actionable summary below. Happy to hop on a quick call if procurement wants line-item detail.

Summary (ballpark pricing, EU region):
- Audit log retention (monthly per-contract): 30 days = €400/mo; 90 days = €700/mo; 365 days = €1,600/mo. Includes immutable object store + retrieval API.
- KMS/HSM: Two options:
  • Seat model: one-time setup €4,000 (HSM provisioning & key escrow) + €800/seat/month.
  • Throughput model: no setup fee, usage-based at €0.015 per signing operation; recommended if signing volume is bursty.
- Data residency surcharge: +12% on hosted usage when pinned to EU-only tenancy (covers isolated infra + enhanced logging).

Pilot concession we can offer today (subject to legal SOW):
Option A — Minimal commitment: 25% off hosted usage + waived HSM setup fee for first 3 months (seats billed) if you sign a simple SOW for a 6-month pilot.
Option B — Revenue-favoring concession: waive setup fee and 30% off hosted usage for 3 months in exchange for a 12-month post-pilot commitment at a defined PRICING FLOOR (we'd need finance approval).

I'm looping in our pricing & partnerships contacts internally to confirm which option is feasible without escalating to rev ops. Attached a quick pricing table and pilot playbook.

Next step: can you confirm whether MedVera prefers seat-based HSM or throughput pricing for the pilot? That will determine if we can fully waive the setup fee.

Cheers,
So — Soojin Lee
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com | +44 20 5555 1234

Attachments: Compliance_Pack_Pricing.xlsx; pilot_playbook_v1.docx

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: 2028-03-06T09:03:00Z
Subject: Fwd: Clarify compliance add-on billing for pilot — suggested concessions

Marissa, Jonas — forwarding Alex's procurement asks and my proposed options (below). They want procurement-ready numbers by Friday. Quick asks:

1) Can we approve Option A (25% off + waive setup fee for 3 months) without additional CFO signoff?
2) If not, what guardrails would we need for Option B to pass finance (e.g., minimum 12-month commit, MRR floor)?

My thinking: MedVera is a strategic potential health customer in EU; getting pilot and case study could justify an initial concession. Prefer to avoid long-term crediting schemes.

Quoted from my reply to Alex:
> Option A — Minimal commitment: 25% off hosted usage + waived HSM setup fee for first 3 months (seats billed) if you sign a simple SOW for a 6-month pilot.
> Option B — Revenue-favoring concession: waive setup fee and 30% off hosted usage for 3 months in exchange for a 12-month post-pilot commitment at a defined PRICING FLOOR (we'd need finance approval).

Thoughts?
Thanks,
So

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: 2028-03-06T10:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Fwd: Clarify compliance add-on billing for pilot — suggested concessions

On 2028-03-06 Soojin Lee wrote:
> My thinking: MedVera is a strategic potential health customer in EU; getting pilot and case study could justify an initial concession.

Agree with the case-study rationale. Finance will allow a limited waiver if we tie it to a post-pilot commercial trigger. Two concrete options we can present to the customer:

- Offer 1 (Pilot-first): Waive the €4,000 HSM setup fee + 25% off hosted usage for months 1–3. Requirement: execute 12-month commitment within 30 days after pilot end at no lower than 85% of list price (protects floor).
- Offer 2 (Short pilot): 30% off hosted usage months 1–3, charge full HSM setup fee but cap total payable to €2,000 if they convert to a 12-month contract. Requirement: signed 6-month pilot SOW only (no post-pilot commit).

If we pick Offer 1, legal needs to add a simple conversion clause to SOW; if Offer 2, we can keep SOW minimal. Recommend Offer 1 for strategic value — protects revenue and incentivizes conversion.

Also recommend capping HSM seats to 3 for the pilot and including a one-time migration assist (up to 8 hours) included free. I've modeled both in the attached concession workbook.

Marissa
Director, Commercial Finance

Attachments: pilot_concession_model.xlsx

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2028-03-07T14:23:00Z
Subject: Re: Fwd: Clarify compliance add-on billing for pilot — suggested concessions

So — small operational notes:
- Finance is okay with Offer 1 if we hard-cap the waived exposure (max €6k value) and include the 85% floor Marissa suggested.
- Engineering can commit to allow EU-only tenancy for the pilot provided we schedule provisioning two weeks after SOW countersigned; residency surcharge stands.
- Suggest we propose a maximum of 3 HSM seats for pilot (as Marissa recommended) and include a one-time migration assist.

If you want to present both options to Alex, I can run the back-of-envelope ARR impact and approve the offer wording.

Jonas
Head of Partnerships

Note: updated concession math attached (pilot_concession_model.xlsx)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>

Subject: Final pilot pricing & two options for MedVera (SOW next steps)

Alex — apologies for the delay; internal approvals took a beat. Below are two concrete offers your procurement can choose from. Both are EU-region pricing and assume pilot volumes are light (low token/embedding usage).

Offer A — Strategic conversion (recommended)
- Audit log retention: 90 days included for €700/mo.
- HSM: waive €4,000 setup fee; seats billed at €800/seat/month; pilot capped to 3 seats.
- Data residency surcharge: +12% on hosted usage.
- Discount: 25% off hosted usage for months 1–3 of pilot.
- Requirement: Execute 12-month commercial agreement within 30 days post-pilot at a minimum of 85% of list pricing.

Offer B — Short pilot, lighter commitment
- Audit log retention: 90 days included for €700/mo.
- HSM: €4,000 setup fee (full) but cap total payable to €2,000 if you convert to a 12-month contract. Seats billed at €800/seat/month; pilot capped to 3 seats.
- Data residency surcharge: +12% on hosted usage.
- Discount: 30% off hosted usage for months 1–3.
- Requirement: Signed 6-month pilot SOW (no conversion requirement).

Attachments: SOW_MedVera_Pilot-v2.pdf (SOW reflects Offer A language by default).

Next steps: If either option looks good, reply with your preferred option and I will send the SOW (DocuSign link) and a one-page summary for procurement. We can also schedule a short call to walk procurement through the conversion clause and the HSM seat vs throughput trade-off.

Thanks — looking forward to getting you set up.
